scope: CPU literal/math checks and result only; neither shader compilation nor rendered appearance/GPU proof. Driver is preserved at curation time; the original result does not record its driver hash. Curation does not rerun this analysis.
limitations: CPU reference transcription checked against shader source markers; no shader compiler or GPU execution.
Depth sampled nearest with Float32 encoding; remaining JS arithmetic uses doubles, not every GPU Float32 operation.
Analytic fields exercise finite planes, corners, screen edges and parallel depth step; do not prove all actual scene depth discontinuities artifact-free.
Above .12 equality is only per-channel contrast-stage equality. Subsequent luma/chroma grading couples channels; AO change affects the whole image.
No current code sets camera.zoom, filmOffset or viewOffset; wbPos is correct for the current symmetric perspective camera.
